title: Broken Bone (Fracture)
immediate_warning: If the bone is piercing the skin or the person cannot move their limbs, call 112 immediately.

immediate_warning_translations.en: If the bone is piercing the skin or the person cannot move their limbs, call 112 immediately.
immediate_warning_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the bone is piercing the skin or the person cannot move their limbs, call 112 immediately.
immediate_warning_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the bone is piercing the skin or the person cannot move their limbs, call 112 immediately.
immediate_warning_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the bone is piercing the skin or the person cannot move their limbs, call 112 immediately.
immediate_warning_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the bone is piercing the skin or the person cannot move their limbs, call 112 immediately.

description: A broken bone (fracture) requires immobilisation to prevent further injury. Never try to straighten the bone.

description_translations.en: A broken bone (fracture) requires immobilisation to prevent further injury. Never try to straighten the bone.
description_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A broken bone (fracture) requires immobilisation to prevent further injury. Never try to straighten the bone.
description_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A broken bone (fracture) requires immobilisation to prevent further injury. Never try to straighten the bone.
description_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A broken bone (fracture) requires immobilisation to prevent further injury. Never try to straighten the bone.
description_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] A broken bone (fracture) requires immobilisation to prevent further injury. Never try to straighten the bone.

steps.instruction: Keep the person still and calm. Do not attempt to move them if a spine injury is possible.

instruction_translations.en: Keep the person still and calm. Do not attempt to move them if a spine injury is possible.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person still and calm. Do not attempt to move them if a spine injury is possible.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person still and calm. Do not attempt to move them if a spine injury is possible.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person still and calm. Do not attempt to move them if a spine injury is possible.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Keep the person still and calm. Do not attempt to move them if a spine injury is possible.

steps.instruction: Immobilise the injured limb in the position you find it — use a splint made from stiff material (wood, rolled newspaper) padded with cloth.

instruction_translations.en: Immobilise the injured limb in the position you find it — use a splint made from stiff material (wood, rolled newspaper) padded with cloth.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Immobilise the injured limb in the position you find it — use a splint made from stiff material (wood, rolled newspaper) padded with cloth.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Immobilise the injured limb in the position you find it — use a splint made from stiff material (wood, rolled newspaper) padded with cloth.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Immobilise the injured limb in the position you find it — use a splint made from stiff material (wood, rolled newspaper) padded with cloth.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Immobilise the injured limb in the position you find it — use a splint made from stiff material (wood, rolled newspaper) padded with cloth.

steps.instruction: If bone is through skin, cover with a clean cloth. Do not push it back.

instruction_translations.en: If bone is through skin, cover with a clean cloth. Do not push it back.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If bone is through skin, cover with a clean cloth. Do not push it back.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If bone is through skin, cover with a clean cloth. Do not push it back.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If bone is through skin, cover with a clean cloth. Do not push it back.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If bone is through skin, cover with a clean cloth. Do not push it back.

steps.instruction: Apply an ice pack wrapped in cloth to reduce swelling. Do not apply ice directly to skin.

instruction_translations.en: Apply an ice pack wrapped in cloth to reduce swelling. Do not apply ice directly to skin.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Apply an ice pack wrapped in cloth to reduce swelling. Do not apply ice directly to skin.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Apply an ice pack wrapped in cloth to reduce swelling. Do not apply ice directly to skin.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Apply an ice pack wrapped in cloth to reduce swelling. Do not apply ice directly to skin.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Apply an ice pack wrapped in cloth to reduce swelling. Do not apply ice directly to skin.

steps.instruction: Elevate the injured limb if possible to reduce swelling.

instruction_translations.en: Elevate the injured limb if possible to reduce swelling.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Elevate the injured limb if possible to reduce swelling.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Elevate the injured limb if possible to reduce swelling.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Elevate the injured limb if possible to reduce swelling.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Elevate the injured limb if possible to reduce swelling.

steps.instruction: Transport to hospital carefully, keeping the limb still.

instruction_translations.en: Transport to hospital carefully, keeping the limb still.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Transport to hospital carefully, keeping the limb still.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Transport to hospital carefully, keeping the limb still.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Transport to hospital carefully, keeping the limb still.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Transport to hospital carefully, keeping the limb still.

do_not: Do not try to straighten the bone.
Do not ignore a suspected fracture.
